facts: MID192 is authenticated HTTP discovery and its consumers require host, port and room_id.
WORLD, SERVICE and GUILD TCP login all reuse token, region and room_id.
PLAYER_NOTICE and WORLD_NOTICE are present in the generic socket MID-to-event mapping.
FORCE_RELOAD is special-cased only on the WORLD socket; it is not present in the generic MID-to-event mapping for service/guild sockets.
No current-source evidence authorizes Wave E to invent Mail/Arena/Guild business notice schemas.

native.role: Wave-D wire/framing authority remains unchanged; Wave E changes routing/publication ownership only.

epistemic_boundary: Default player publication to WORLD, sequence zero and server operational queue policies remain explicit compatibility/operational decisions rather than recovered original-server implementation facts.
